name: Mallorca
about: Peak summer (Jul–Aug) is hot, crowded, and the busiest party season; spring and fall (Mar–May, Sep–Nov) bring mild weather and are when professional cycling teams train in the Tramuntana mountains.
overview: Gothic Palma, the UNESCO-listed Serra de Tramuntana mountains, and Europe's top road-cycling destination — far more range than its party-island reputation.
costOverview: Palma's old town is reasonable for coffee and tapas — beach-club prices and peak-season villa rentals are where costs climb fast.
